name: issue-pr-review/revert-squash
prompt: /issue-pr-review 12 --revert --auto: revert squash-merged PR #12 (Closes #7) through a new PR and reopen #7

grade.label: one revert PR against main from the fix branch, one reopen and one comment; no merge, no repo-settings call
main on the remote is unchanged: the revert lands only through the PR (AC1)
only the revert branch is pushed
the revert removes what the squash commit added
the revert commit keeps git's This reverts commit <sha> line
the revert branch follows the naming convention
the Revert "…" subject is skipped by the commit check, not failed
the revert PR body carries both marker lines and no closing keyword
the reopen comment links the revert PR (AC2)
issue #7 reads OPEN after the reopen (AC2)
the revert_opened row validates (pr = reverted PR, revert_pr = new PR)

criteria: The report names the revert PR's URL on its own line.
The report says the issue was reopened and links the revert PR.
Nothing in the output says the revert was merged or pushed to main.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests the documented revert procedure, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
